principles: Advisory-only: never affect gates or the reviewRunId binding
Mirror the existing grillSection advisory pattern
Rank by priority with support shown; top-N + progressive disclosure
Reuse learning-store(read) + appendActivityLog; zero outward coupling from the loader
Deterministic promptHash stays independent of hint content
drivers: Determinism: hints must not change reviewRunId promptHash
Auditability: usage tracked via the activity log

options.name: advisory-section-separate-from-promptHash
pros: Mirrors the proven grillSection advisory pattern in story-review
Hints live in a channel separate from resolveReviewPromptHash -> deterministic reviewRunId binding unaffected
Reuses learning-store (read) + appendActivityLog; minimal new surface
cons: Hints are advisory and may be ignored
Loader ranking heuristics need a smoke to pin behavior

options.name: inject-into-reviewer-promptHash-prompt
pros: Hints guaranteed in front of the reviewer
cons: Changes reviewRunId promptHash run-to-run as signals accumulate -> breaks reproducibility/freshness (violates determinism guardrail)

rationale: The execution plan mandates advisory-only surfacing that never enters the promptHash domain; folding hints into the reviewer promptHash prompt would break reproducibility. Mirroring grillSection keeps it in the proven advisory channel.

preMortem.trigger: Hint content folded into resolveReviewPromptHash input
preMortem.consequence: Same code/material yields a different reviewRunId binding as signals grow -> reproducibility/freshness breaks
preMortem.mitigation: Keep hints in a channel separate from resolveReviewPromptHash; smoke asserts promptHash identical with/without hint content

preMortem.scenario: A low-support one-hit signal ranks to the top
preMortem.mitigation: priority = signalScore*log(1+support)*recencyBoost; show support alongside score; top-N cap
loader imports only learning-store(read)+types; smoke static-scans imports

preMortem.scenario: Usage events are unauditable or duplicated
preMortem.mitigation: single experience_hint_surfaced event via appendActivityLog; smoke asserts exactly-once on surface
